art_direction: 阿尼亚穿黄色雨衣和雨靴，在浅浅水洼边开心停步。
composition_variation: Portray Anya Forger in a fully covering lemon-yellow raincoat and matching rain boots, pausing beside a shallow puddle on a quiet neighborhood path. Her pink hair and black hair ornaments peek from the hood. She looks down with a delighted curious expression. Use glossy cel shading, lilac pavement reflections, gentle drizzle, and mint hedges, placing her entire small figure in the lower center. Build an original peaceful portrait wallpaper, never a replica of existing artwork. Keep the upper 28% empty and quiet for the clock. Design at 1024x1536 for the central x158-866 crop, with the face inside x240-784. No text, logos, UI, weapons, violence, or extra characters.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory anime-wallpapers-100/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
